project: Wuxia Life P43 Archetype Recap And Ending Differentiation
description: Strengthen whole-life payoff by making dominant shaping directions and archetype differences more explicit in recap, life memory, and ending-level output.

userStories.title: Audit current endgame and recap differentiation gaps
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a gap audit of endgame recap and archetype differentiation so P43 targets the weakest closing surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory current recap and ending surfaces that express life trajectory or archetype
Identify where shaping is lost, flattened, or repeated across archetypes
Rank the highest-value recap and ending gaps
Save audit under docs/test-reports/p43-ending-differentiation-gap-audit.md
Do not change gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Add dominant shaping recap to late-life summary
userStories.description: As a player, I want late-life recap to explicitly name the dominant long-term forces that shaped my life, so the whole run feels causally legible.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or revise recap output so it names dominant shaping directions in player-facing language
Recap connects shaping direction to visible life consequences or identity
Avoid raw internal state output
Add targeted regression coverage for recap derivation

userStories.title: Differentiate archetype endings by shaping pattern
userStories.description: As a player, I want two runs in the same broad route family to still end with different tones or summaries when their long-term shaping patterns differ.
acceptanceCriteria: Select at least 2 archetype families and 2 shaping patterns per family
Add or revise ending or recap content so these patterns are visibly distinct
Differentiation is readable in player-facing output, not only hidden diagnostics
Document sample before and after cases under docs/test-reports/p43-archetype-ending-delta-matrix.md

userStories.title: Bind life memory, recap, and ending language together
userStories.description: As a player, I want my life-memory summary, late recap, and ending language to feel like one coherent interpretation of the same life rather than three disconnected summaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Review terminology consistency across life memory, recap, and ending surfaces
Align major labels for martial, scholarly, livelihood, social, and family shaping
Remove obvious contradictions or duplicate phrasing patterns
Add targeted regression or snapshot coverage where appropriate

userStories.title: P43 regression and closure
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want regression coverage and closure evidence that archetype and ending differentiation improved without breaking prior shaping features.
acceptanceCriteria: Run typecheck
Run existing habit and recap related tests
Add at least one isolated P43 regression asserting differentiated recap or ending output
Save closure under docs/test-reports/p43-archetype-recap-ending-closure.md
Closure lists remaining flattening areas clearly
